development_source_attribution.scope: Development-only physical-line attribution in existing trajectories. Count each source line once, at its first actual observation; separate original tool output from completion. Annotation overlap is diagnostic, includes physical blank/comment lines, and is not the official score or a counterfactual online ablation. Repeated traces cover the same eight tasks. Non-annotated source may still help solving.
development_source_attribution.conclusion: All 220 graph-returned physical lines were already observed in the targeted-hop development trial. Grep completion contributes most new completion lines and most newly observed annotated lines; no causal claim that removing it improves an online agent. Next development gates must measure useful novel source. Do not tune on the completed independent 32.

Require an adoption/novelty mechanism check before another quality cohort; no new independent validation or full-500 run.

offline.anchor_rule: First actual read response intersecting a compiler callable. Choose maximum count of returned physical lines in a callable, then smallest callable span and lexical name; use its earliest observed line. This rule is fixed before annotation overlap is measured.
offline.observations: Actual source-checked message prefix through that read; both directions use the same prefix independently.
offline.annotation_use: Only compute overlap after anchor selection and graph responses. Do not select a better anchor from annotations.
offline.neighbor_order_change: Functions/methods precede other defined symbols within the same 1000-raw-edge scan; stable edge order within groups.
offline.interpretation: Only the Go anchor adds annotated source; its previous annotated line is displaced. Physical blank/comment lines are counted. This is not official Recall/F1 or an online quality score.

first_callable_graph_mechanism.conclusion: The revised source-observation trigger passes a one-task mechanism gate with 132 new annotated physical lines. This establishes no Recall/F1 or Pass@1 gain. Preserve both versions and the earlier negative independent validation. Broader fresh matched development evidence is required before a new independent quality selection.
